title: Development of magnesium-doped zinc oxide nanopowders for conductometric acetone gas sensors

This research investigates magnesium-doped zinc oxide nanoparticles (NPs) synthesised by a modified sol–gel technique to create a high-performance gas sensing device with an enhanced sensing layer.
